# awscc_cloudwatch_metric_data_query_definition (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::CloudWatch::MetricDataQueryDefinition



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the metric data query definition.
- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the metric data query definition was created.
- `expression` (String) The metric query. It is stored as-is and is not validated.
- `metric_data_query_definition_id` (String) The ID of the metric data query definition, generated by the service.
- `path` (String) The name of the metric data query definition. Use '/' to organize definitions into folders. Must be unique in the account and Region. Changing it renames the definition in place.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) An array of key-value pairs to apply to the metric data query definition. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `type` (String) The query language of Expression.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the metric data query definition was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The key of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value of the tag.
